title: Elective Inpatient Admission

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.text: This synthetic policy identifies information used to prepare a service request for human review.

sections.heading: Coverage Criteria
sections.text:
- The request identifies the reason inpatient-level care is being considered.
- The record describes severity, monitoring needs and planned interventions.
- The documentation explains why a lower level of care may be insufficient.

sections.heading: Required Documentation
sections.text:
- Primary diagnosis and relevant comorbidities
- Current symptoms, examination and test results
- Planned treatments, procedures and monitoring
- Expected length of stay
- Reason outpatient or observation care may be insufficient

sections.heading: Limitations and Exceptions
sections.text:
- Network status does not establish the appropriate level of care.
- Emergency admissions may follow a separate notification workflow.
- An authorized reviewer makes the final determination.

sections.heading: Decision Boundary
sections.text: Meeting the listed criteria does not automatically approve the request. Eligibility, benefits, exclusions, clinical context and applicable requirements must be reviewed by an authorized human reviewer.

disclaimer: Synthetic policy created for software demonstration and evaluation. It is not medical or insurance guidance.
